[F002] All four findings are addressed:

**Finding 1 (high — dry-run still calls push_status):** Rewrote `external_refs_sync.run_close_push` (`external_refs_sync.py:260-278`) so the dry-run branch constructs a PENDING `ExternalSyncRecord` via `make_pending_record` BEFORE adapter resolution — `hook.push_status` is never invoked. The pending record carries `{"uri": …, "intended_status": …}` so operators still see what would be sent. Updated `test_close_dry_run_writes_pending_and_does_not_call_vendor` to assert `hook.push_calls == []` and the new payload shape; updated `test_format_dry_run_preview_renders_intended_payload` accordingly.

**Finding 2 (medium — ExternalSyncRecord not exposed from plan_loader):** Added a re-export at `plan_loader.py:36-39` so `from dontpanic_orchestrate.plan_loader import ExternalSyncRecord, ExternalSyncStatus` works. Added `test_plan_loader_exposes_external_sync_record` (identity check, not just `hasattr`) to lock the contract.

**Finding 3 (medium — missing contract doc):** Wrote `docs/plans/2026-05-20-001-infra-external-integrations-bridge-v0/evidence/external-refs-contract.md` documenting frontmatter shape, lifecycle hooks (lock / close / resync), full status-transition truth tables, the 4-state state machine diagram, retry semantics, failure-surface playbook, and code references.

**Finding 4 (medium — sweep + commands_run not captured):** Ran targeted F002 tests (19 pass) and the full orchestrator sweep (2202 passed, 7 skipped, 1 warning) — captured
